messages:
tess: Hotfix ready for urgent crash seen in prod when input contains malformed unicode sequences. Patch: `redwood/serving:2.5.0-hotfix-unicode` (small sanitizer). No schema or client changes. Asking for 00:15 UTC window. Plan: smoke -> 2% canary -> 50% -> 100% with quick checks. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.2% over 2m OR error patterns match unicode-sanitizer exceptions.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received from @tess
- image: `redwood/serving:2.5.0-hotfix-unicode`
- targets: eu-west1,canary-pool
- strategy: staged canary (2% -> 50% -> 100%)
- smoke job: `smoke/unicode-sanitize`

omar: any impact on embeddings or tokenizer outputs?

tess: no embedding change, tokenizer output stable. sanitizer only drops/normalizes invalid bytes.

frida: I can approve expedited if ops oncall watches and we pin dedicated pools. ops-bot: paging oncall.

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @omar (high)  please ack within 5m.

omar: ack. I'll monitor and can trigger rollback.

frida: add runbook link and short release note please.

tess: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unicode-sanitizer. release note: "2.5.0-hotfix-unicode: sanitize malformed unicode to prevent serializer crashes. No client changes."

deploy-bot: CLI preview:
```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.5.0-hotfix-unicode \
  --targets eu-west1,canary-pool \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 2 --canary-duration 10m \
  --follow-up-steps "50% in 5m if green, 100% in 10m" --smoke smoke/unicode-sanitize \
  --rollback-probe "5xx>0.2||exceptions:unicode_sanitizer"
```

tess: starting smoke now, will update in ~90s.

(90s later)
tess: smoke passed, no sanitizer exceptions. kicking 2% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 2% at 3112223325. Observability hooks active.

omar: watching traces and exception filters. all clear so far.

(7m later)
tess: ramping to 50% per fast-approve. leaving ops watch for 10m, then 100% if green.

(12m later)
tess: ramp complete to 100% at 3112223440. monitoring for 30m post-deploy. thanks for quick turnaround :rocket:

frida: thanks all. please add post-deploy summary to the PR and tag support for visibility.

tess: will do, attaching traces and the runbook link to the release PR now.
